description: Ivan's collection of agent skills, packaged as a Codex plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Operation manuals grounded in the live app, uncertainty manifests, and fresh-eyes cross-review.
interface.longDescription: Ivan's curated agent skills. Ships webapp-manual (build or maintain a web system's operation manual, 操作說明書 / 操作手冊, as a .docx grounded in the live running app), uncertainty-manifest (force hidden assumptions into a structured, confidence-tagged Manifest before implementation), and cross-review (fresh-eyes sub-agent review of specs, plans, and PRs — blocking on Critical findings before push).
